title: ℂ[S₃] ≅ ℂ × ℂ × M₂(ℂ) has dimension 6
caption: Each factor of the Artin–Wedderburn decomposition contributes the square of an irreducible's dimension: ℂ gives 1, ℂ gives 1 and M₂(ℂ) gives 4. They add to 6 = |S₃|, the dimension of the group algebra.
alt: One bar of 6 units split into three parts: 1 for ℂ, 1 for ℂ and 4 for M₂(ℂ).
description: S₃ has irreducible representations of dimensions 1, 1 and 2.
A d-dimensional irreducible gives a block M_d(ℂ) of dimension d².
